title: SSA impersonation, suspended number, wire to new payee

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: This is Officer Reynolds with the Social Security Administration. Your Social Security number has been suspended because it was used to open accounts tied to drug trafficking in Texas.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: That cannot be right. I have never been to Texas.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: I believe you, ma'am, which is why I am calling before the warrant is executed. To protect your savings you must wire nine thousand eight hundred to the Federal Resolution Department today. Marshals will come to arrest you if this is not resolved by five pm.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: I do not want to be arrested. What do I need to do?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Stay on the line with me and open your banking app. Do not hang up.

review_note: Classic SSA script with warrant threat and same-day wire to a new payee. H-01 and H-03 catch it on facts alone; authority, threat and urgency signals should also fire.
